title: Most news apps are designed to keep you scrolling, not to help you understand.
body:
We have all been there. You read a headline, scan a few paragraphs, and feel like you know the story. But an hour later, the details are gone. You have the information, but you do not have the context.

That is why we built Deep Dive Mode at Headlinne. Instead of just giving you the latest update, it pulls back the curtain on the story. It connects the dots between what is happening today and why it matters in the long run. It provides the background, the history, and the different perspectives that usually get buried in a standard news feed.

Technology should work for your curiosity, not against it. Real understanding comes from having the right context at the right time. We believe that if you spend five minutes reading, you should walk away feeling five minutes smarter, not just five minutes more anxious.
cta: You can see how it works for yourself at HEADLINNE.com.
